mapper.insert: INSERT INTO following (id, from_user_id, to_user_id, rel_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{relStatus}, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rel_status=VALUES(rel_status), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE following SET rel_status=0, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND to_user_id=#{toUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO follower (id, to_user_id, from_user_id, rel_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{toUserId}, #{fromUserId}, #{relStatus}, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE follower SET rel_status=0, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status=1
UPDATE follower SET rel_status=1, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM following WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status=1
SELECT to_user_id FROM following WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT from_user_id FROM follower WHERE to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT to_user_id AS toUserId, created_at AS createdAt FROM following WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT from_user_id AS fromUserId, created_at AS createdAt FROM follower WHERE to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM following WHERE from_user_id=#{fromUserId} AND rel_status=1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM follower WHERE to_user_id=#{toUserId} AND rel_status=1
